scope: 2025 exact S級予選, 後半, main line size >=3, branch B rough-lean only

candidate_pool_decision.note: Adding R2L instead of M3 is materially weaker, especially in H2. Adding R2L on top of this five-rider set produced no additional top3-set captures in H2.

decision: Use the 27-point formation as the first fixed rough-branch strategy to simulate. It preserves the same direction in H1/H2 and avoids paying 9 extra points for only 4 additional structural hits across 60 normal races. Keep 36 points as a comparison arm, not the default.
